note: Export side is factually confirmed by dated customs/B-L records, not by website claims: 5 distinct shipments visible 2025-06-28 to 2026-02-12 to UAE (Jebel Ali), UK (London Heathrow), Spain (Madrid) and an ICD lane, with B/L numbers 9622263, 8666982, 8047894, 0399525, 2943405. Declared HS 853890 matches the two most recent 85389000 lines (brass stand-off, brass insert), but the company also ships under 74198030 (brass terminals/duese) — so the declared code is correct but not exclusive; per project rules this is not a rejection ground, actual HS should be recorded as 85389000 with 74198030 as a secondary code. Address on record: Plot No. B-2/B, in front of Post Office, G.I.D.C. Udyognagar (Gujarat, Jamnagar area). Domestic supply evidence (GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tenders, contracts, annual-report splits) could NOT be retrieved: the web_search backend returned connection refused on both attempts, and volza/eximpedia/trademo/thecompanycheck returned HTTP 403. Therefore domestic_status = unknown, not none_found — absence of evidence here is a tooling limitation, not a finding. Revenue and export volume figures are not public in the free views and are left null; no numbers were estimated. Slug note: 'sagar-brass-industries' (plural) carries the records; 'sagar-brass-industry' (singular) resolves to an empty page. Role: appears to be a manufacturer-exporter of brass components (own GIDC plot, part numbers per customer drawings), though the 2025-06-28 line shows it also appearing as buyer-side party in a Kingston Holdings FZE lane — consistent with manufacturer_trader, not verified.
